items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Mouse and his Music, we played different little small towns around Parsons.

ctx.x: TRICE. And Mouse and his Music, we played different little small towns around Parsons. But that's where I first heard Louis Armstrong, the first record I ever heard was of Louis Armstrong. And I was quite impressed, you know with Louis. Everybody was quite impressed.

I remember one of my acts with Mouse, I had to put on a top hat a long silk coat and take a plunger, and I had some kind of a preaching act I had to do (at)a plunger, to "St. James' Infirmary." That was my act.
